description: Defines the SiloInstanceRecord class, which models a record representing a silo instance in a distributed Orleans cluster. It includes properties for metadata such as deployment ID, silo identity, network address, status, and related attributes. It also provides methods for serialization, deserialization from DynamoDB attribute dictionaries, string representation, and unpacking row keys into silo addresses.

classes.name: SiloInstanceRecord
classes.description: Represents a DynamoDB record for an Orleans silo instance, including properties for its metadata and methods for handling serialization and address unpacking.
